create_input_batch: create an InputBatch instance with max_num_reqs, max_model_len, device, and vocab_size for GPU token batching
add_request_input_batch: add a CachedRequestState to an InputBatch with sampling params, token ids, and block table entries
remove_request_input_batch: remove a request from an InputBatch by req_id and condense the batch to fill empty slots
swap_request_input_batch: swap two requests in an InputBatch by index, exchanging token ids, block tables, and sampling parameters
build_sampling_metadata: build a SamplingMetadata object from InputBatch state including temperature, penalties, and token ids
